name: Christian Cantrell
current_role: Founder and Chief Product (and 'Prompt') Officer, Reve AI (foundation-model and creative-tooling startup, Palo Alto)
profile: Christian Cantrell spent 17 years at Adobe (2005-2022), ending as Director of Experience Development and head of Adobe Design Prototyping, then was VP of Product at Stability AI (2022-23), launching DreamStudio 1.0 and the Stability API. In March 2023 he founded Reve AI, maker of the Reve image-generation model, where he runs product, design and marketing. He is also a published novelist.
interesting_fact: He is a thriller/sci-fi novelist: his novel 'Scorpion' (Random House) began as the short story 'The Epoch Index', optioned by FOX, and he has a series ('Brainbox') developed at Hulu; Publishers Weekly and Kirkus both gave Scorpion starred reviews.
deep_cut_fact: At Macromedia (2002-05) he built and maintained Macromedia's first blog and RSS aggregation platforms; he started his career as a Java developer at Amazing Media, holds a Creative Writing and Literature degree from George Mason, and was named an Adobe Distinguished Inventor in 2022 (22 patents).
notes: His site invites email ('Feel free to email me') but shows the address scrambled behind a decode slider (simple letter-shift of 'inxoyzogt.igtzxkrr@msgor.ius'); the decoded address above is what the slider reveals. Ideal podcast guest: technology + storytelling. Reve co-founders: Michael Gharbi, Taesung Park.

name: Matt Clifford
current_role: Head of International Affairs at Anthropic; co-founder and non-executive Chair, Entrepreneurs First; Chair of ARIA (UK)
profile: British entrepreneur (b. 1985) who left McKinsey to co-found Entrepreneurs First with Alice Bentinck in 2011; EF raised $200M at a $1.3B valuation in 2026. He chairs the UK's Advanced Research and Invention Agency, led preparations for the 2023 Bletchley Park AI Safety Summit, wrote the UK AI Opportunities Action Plan and was the PM's AI Adviser until summer 2025. In September 2026 he joined Anthropic.
interesting_fact: He was named to the TIME AI100, awarded an MBE (2016) and CBE for services to AI (2024), and an October 2025 speech on how to 'Make the UK Rich Again' was viewed well over a million times.
deep_cut_fact: For fun he writes immersive murder-mystery games, some downloadable from his website; he also published annual reviews of every book he read 2015-2019 and wrote the weekly 'Thoughts in Between' newsletter (2018-22). He was a Kennedy Scholar at MIT.
notes: His site says 'You can message me on Twitter' (preferred route) and lists matt@joinef.com. Note: he now works at Anthropic (since Sept 2026; Register reported MPs raised conflict-of-interest concerns) - outreach may route through Anthropic comms for AI topics. Strong fit for energy/data-centre/AI policy themes.

name: Mike Sonnenberg
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, Awardco (Lindon, Utah)
profile: Mike Sonnenberg co-founded Awardco with his cousin Steve Sonnenberg and leads its technology as CTO. Awardco is an employee recognition and rewards platform built around a zero-markup Amazon Business catalogue; it raised a $165M Series B in May 2025 led by Sixth Street Growth, valuing it above $1B, and serves 3,000+ organisations.
interesting_fact: Awardco was the first platform to integrate Amazon's catalogue for employee rewards; Amazon initially rejected the idea and only partnered after Amazon Business launched in 2015.
deep_cut_fact: Mike joined his cousin Steve as Awardco's back-end developer and co-founder when Steve was starting over in 2011; together they hand-selected millions of products to display on the platform before Amazon agreed to partner.
notes: Low public profile; rarely quoted. Founding year varies on Awardco's own pages (2011 build start, 2013 or 2015). Best route is via Awardco. No published press email found; web search budget ran out before a deeper look.
